data.content_ref: inline:The problem asks to determine both when a bounded run 'may later be resumed without corrupting the append-only identity of the recorded events' AND 'when resumption must stay refused.' SRC_001 evades the core question by redefining resumption as a new derived branch (a new run), not a continuation of the same run identity. The countercondition itself concedes this fails if 'resume' means 'continuing the exact same run identity without branching' — which is precisely what the problem is asking about. By asserting resumption is 'always possible' (as a branch), it never identifies any condition under which resumption must stay refused, leaving half the problem unaddressed.
